I cannot say enough good things about Dolly’s Animal Clinic. I’ve been coming here for a few years but I recently had an emergency on a Sunday… After having a really stressful and frustrating experience at another veterinary clinic, coming back here was such a relief.

They saw Patches quickly, immediately understood how serious his paw injury was, and actually took care of the problem same day. They cleaned and treated the wound properly, removed the damaged tissue, stitched his paw, managed his pain, and explained what we needed to do afterward. The entire process felt straightforward and easy, which was exactly what we needed after already being stressed about him.

The difference between our experience here and at the first clinic was honestly night and day. At the other place, we were told he would need blood work but then the bloodwork showed that they couldn’t sedate him…  just to properly clean and examine the paw and were being directed to an animal hospital where the estimate was about $2k. At Dolly’s, they simply evaluated him, figured out what needed to be done, and FIXED IT themselves. They reviewed the bloodwork and said it’s wouldn’t be a problem for sedation.

And did I mention they were affordable?! I was genuinely surprised by how reasonable the cost was, especially considering how much they actually did for him.

Everyone was kind, efficient, practical, and caring. Patches is healing well, and I’m extremely grateful we found Dolly’s Animal Clinic. This will absolutely be the first place I call in the future. Highly recommend!

Went to dollys to see what they could tell me about my dogs masses that she has. The vet, concerned about these being cancerous masses, immediately recommended a body scan, for $1,400. Stupidly I did it. It made no sense. If you are concerned about it being cancerous wouldn't you just jump to a biopsy, what is the point of the body scan? Especially if the dog is showing no signs of distress. Then I confronted the vet about it the next day (after I got over my shock) they gave some really mumbling excuse and said they can do a biopsy for 1,200 additional. So they want 2,600 for the entire process.

I went back to my old vet who is 20 miles away, I moved away 8 years ago. My old vet, did a quick extract from the masses, showed me that it's purely fat on the slide on microscope. $200 to clear the issue of the masses.

Dollys makes you go through unnecessary procedures to fatten the bill, doesn't care about putting their clients needs and using reasonable thinking above the almighty dollar.

I will not be going back to this office ever again and they should be ashamed of themselves.
